hooks.command: f=$(find "$HOME/.openhands/cache/plugins" -name guard.py -path '*/.agents/dev.openhands/hooks/guard.py' -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f2-); if [ -n "$f" ]; then exec python3 "$f"; fi; echo 'account-library guard not found in plugin cache; guard inactive' >&2; exit 0

f=$(find "$HOME/.openhands/cache/plugins" -name quality_gate.sh -path '*/.agents/dev.openhands/hooks/quality_gate.sh' -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f2-); if [ -n "$f" ]; then exec bash "$f"; fi; echo 'account-library quality gate not found in plugin cache; gate inactive' >&2; exit 0
